quests.briefing_md:
# First Sparks

Welcome to the Python Foundry! Your first task is to make the system speak. Many systems use **logging** or **printing** to communicate their internal state. 

### Your Objective
Write a single line of code that uses the `print()` function to output the following text exactly:
`HEllo World` (Note the capitalization).

tiered_hints.guided: Review the concept of **[print](codex:glossary/python/print)** in the Codex.
tiered_hints.full_solution: No full solution provided. Check your syntax and ensure all tests pass.

quests.title: Quest Hello Variable
quests.briefing_md:
# Hello Variable

In programming, we need a way to store and retrieve data as the program runs. We do this using **variables**.

### Your Objective
1. Create a variable named `message`.
2. Assign it the string value `"Foundry Online"`.
3. Print the value of `message` using the `print()` function.
